profile_inheritance: A profile uses its own rules plus all-profile rules. It does not inherit another profile.

Trusted.purpose: Networks explicitly trusted by the owner.

Untrusted.purpose: Airports, hotels, guest networks, and unknown networks.

incoming_local_network_rules.process_binding_instruction: Select the installed configd process and verify its Apple identity and System owner. This metadata is not a validated native import.

Untrusted.boundary_limit: These rules restrict incoming TCP and UDP from Local Network. They do not isolate outgoing Local Network traffic.

Work.incoming_boundary: Use the same reviewed incoming boundary as Untrusted.
required_before_activation: Review required browser, mail, chat, VPN, and developer rules.
Preserve DHCP, DNS, and loopback needs.
Test required workflows and review new alerts.
Work.application_rules: Review required application rules locally. Do not import an installed-app allow inventory from another machine.

vpn_activation.server_specific_activation: Do not infer server identity from an app-only trigger. Keep exact server selectors private.
